verdict.rationale: Supabase documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants query and manage projects, and bundles it into an agent plugin. A runtime probe confirmed the hosted endpoint at mcp.supabase.com is live and uses the MCP OAuth flow. Community reports of a prompt-injection exploit, with mitigations such as read-only by default, are a security caveat rather than evidence that the server fails to work. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of the exposed tool set and per-client setup steps, and a documented answer to the acknowledged prompt-injection risk.
